projects.title: Fleet Reliability Observatory
projects.description: Follow a GPU fleet signal through qualification, workload impact, durable repair and verified recovery in an animated operating story.
projects.scope: Independent reference implementation informed by public engineering research. GPU and workload signals are synthetic; lifecycle transactions, scoped API, real native observability backends and Temporal workflow execution are inspectable. Physical GPU burn-in is skipped. The public site replays recorded execution; it does not run a hosted fleet.
projects.imageKind: Actual walkthrough capture with original concept artwork
projects.why: Connects the signal, safe action, workload result and capacity exposure, with an explicit boundary between simulation and measured execution.

projects.title: AI Incident Investigator
projects.description: Investigate a broken Grafana panel, inspect real local AI execution, review an exact repair and verify recovery.
projects.scope: The checkout workload and fault are synthetic. Grafana, Prometheus, OpenInference spans, panel captures and local model inference are real. Small authored evaluations are reported separately from the deterministic rules; the model remains advisory.
projects.why: Makes the operational evidence, AI behavior, review decision and recovery independently inspectable.

projects.title: Data Center Explorer
projects.description: Explore a connected Grafana view from data center and hall to row, rack, chassis and individual GPU.
projects.scope: All telemetry comes from a local Python simulator. Grafana dashboards and drill-down links execute; infrastructure names, faults, histories and visual geometry are demo data or illustrations. Screenshots show the running local dashboards, not a public live fleet.
projects.why: Makes hierarchy, power rollups, cooling relationships and a single fault understandable through dashboards as code and contextual navigation.

projects.title: Grafana Living Visuals
projects.description: Explore animated heartbeat, data-hall, GPU-cluster, and server-chassis views inside Grafana.
projects.scope: All bundled readings are fictional or simulated. These are editable visualization examples, not a live infrastructure or health feed.
projects.why: Explore animated heartbeat, data-hall, GPU-cluster, and server-chassis views inside Grafana.

projects.title: Grafana Panel Agent
projects.description: Detect empty Grafana panels, investigate the cause, review a query repair, and retain the recovery history.
projects.scope: The demonstration uses real Grafana and Prometheus with synthetic checkout telemetry. Repairs remain subject to review.
projects.why: Detect empty Grafana panels, investigate the cause, review a query repair, and retain the recovery history.

projects.title: Incident Experiment Lab
projects.description: Compare volatile and durable queues using event identities, injected failures, and delivery accounting.
projects.scope: Simulation and live local HTTP experiments are separate modes; recovery results apply to the declared experiment.
projects.why: Compare volatile and durable queues using event identities, injected failures, and delivery accounting.

projects.title: IncidentLens
projects.description: Investigate an incident across metrics, logs, and traces, then inspect the evidence behind each hypothesis.
projects.scope: The recorded proof uses deterministic replay. Remediation stays at a human review boundary; the demo does not establish live production accuracy.
projects.why: A useful starting point for seeing how a bounded investigation agent connects telemetry, competing explanations, and human review.

projects.title: Metrics Governance POC
projects.description: Define metric contracts and reject instrumentation drift with OpenTelemetry, Weaver, and CI checks.
projects.scope: The lab uses synthetic services that emit actual SDK metrics. It demonstrates contract enforcement, rather than a production governance service.
projects.why: Define metric contracts and reject instrumentation drift with OpenTelemetry, Weaver, and CI checks.

projects.title: Observability Conference Lab
projects.description: Troubleshoot a small distributed system and inspect a local AI support agent alongside its telemetry.
projects.scope: The local three-service lab is a separate implementation from the upstream OpenTelemetry demo. See the README for recorded execution and environment limits.
projects.why: Troubleshoot a small distributed system and inspect a local AI support agent alongside its telemetry.

projects.title: OpenTelemetry Zero to Hero
projects.description: Follow a request from logs and metrics to spans, Collector pipelines, and hands-on Python labs.
projects.scope: Illustrations, local SDK experiments, and lab execution boundaries are explained in the course documentation.
projects.why: Follow a request from logs and metrics to spans, Collector pipelines, and hands-on Python labs.

projects.title: PromQL Zero to Hero
projects.description: Learn PromQL through animated concepts, SQL comparisons, practice checks, and real query labs.
projects.scope: A local learning academy for understanding measurements and query behavior.
projects.why: Learn PromQL through animated concepts, SQL comparisons, practice checks, and real query labs.

projects.title: Redfish Observatory
projects.description: Operate a simulated server rack, practice Redfish management, and follow hardware and application signals through OpenTelemetry.
projects.scope: Server hardware, sensors, faults, and management effects are simulated; OpenTelemetry exports and request timings are real. The API is a teaching subset rather than a Redfish-conformant implementation. In-app management controls target the simulator, while optional hardware examples run separately. The lab is intended for local learning and uses disposable data.
projects.why: A hands-on bridge from server management to metrics, logs, and traces: compare polling with pushed reports and connect hardware events to application behavior.

projects.title: SPL Zero to Hero
projects.description: Watch data change while learning Splunk SPL through runnable SQL comparisons and query challenges.
projects.scope: The independent browser academy uses synthetic events and a supported SPL implementation. It does not require a Splunk account.
projects.why: Watch data change while learning Splunk SPL through runnable SQL comparisons and query challenges.

projects.title: SeriesScope
projects.description: Explore Prometheus labels, learn cardinality, and compare transparent metrics-cost scenarios.
projects.scope: The initial dataset is synthetic. Vendor cost views are editable scenarios, not billing guarantees.
projects.why: Explore Prometheus labels, learn cardinality, and compare transparent metrics-cost scenarios.

projects.title: SignalOps
projects.description: Turn Prometheus metrics, Splunk events, and logs into findings with evidence and verification queries.
projects.scope: Sample data is labeled. Findings are review candidates; the tool does not change infrastructure or estimate financial savings.
projects.why: Turn Prometheus metrics, Splunk events, and logs into findings with evidence and verification queries.

projects.title: SignalStory
projects.description: Learn observability by predicting, watching, and experimenting with one connected checkout story.
projects.scope: The public playground contains browser exercises. The Python studio adds real engines and optional tutoring.
projects.why: An approachable route into observability that connects the meaning of a signal with queries and instrumentation.

projects.title: Telemetry Cardinality Governor
projects.description: Govern telemetry cardinality through durable approval, measured canaries, protected-signal checks and rollback.
projects.scope: The workload is synthetic; Temporal execution, Prometheus scrapes, configuration reloads and crash recovery are real. Production denotes an isolated lab scrape pool. The mitigation drops an optional metric family by exact name; measured reductions do not establish immediate disk reclamation or financial savings.
projects.why: Explore durable approval, canary validation, and recovery without treating an isolated lab as a production fleet.

projects.title: Telemetry Release Gate
projects.description: Make telemetry contracts a release criterion before a change breaks dashboards or increases series counts.
projects.scope: Fixture analysis and live local-container modes are distinguished in each report.
projects.why: Make telemetry contracts a release criterion before a change breaks dashboards or increases series counts.

projects.title: Telemetry Reliability Lab
projects.description: Run bounded failure experiments to see where telemetry is lost and what survives recovery.
projects.scope: The workload is synthetic. Collector delivery, backend signals, and recovery are measured in isolated local experiments.
projects.why: Run bounded failure experiments to see where telemetry is lost and what survives recovery.

projects.title: AI Factory Observability Lab
projects.description: Connect GPU, fabric and workload signals to an owner and runbook through a runnable AI infrastructure observability lab.
projects.scope: A personal laptop lab with simulated hardware and workload feeds by default. The Prometheus, Grafana and Alertmanager services are real. Live-input adapters and optional PyTorch/NIM tools are implemented; GPU hardware and proprietary deployments require separate access and validation.
projects.why: Demonstrates source contracts, missing-data coverage, node-aware correlation and useful-work indicators across the infrastructure stack.

projects.title: Agent Tool Sandbox
projects.description: Inspect policy, execution limits, and audit evidence for Python jobs inside Apple Container VMs.
projects.scope: Static preview does not run submitted code. Live execution requires the declared local-container setup and uses bounded policies.
projects.why: Inspect policy, execution limits, and audit evidence for Python jobs inside Apple Container VMs.

projects.title: GPU FleetOps · Reliability Intelligence
projects.description: Measure GPU fleet interruptions, compare provider cohorts, and evaluate reliability improvements with reproducible statistical evidence.
projects.scope: A reproducible synthetic fleet lab with a Gradio application, operator API, censored statistics, matched cohorts and a local DCGM readiness path. Replay scale is logical record count. No physical GPU or customer fleet was available for this recorded extension; predictive metrics and mitigation outcomes are synthetic.
projects.why: Connects fleet observability and customer-facing engineering to explicit reliability measurement, controlled validation and engineering priorities.
projects.imageKind: Calculated Matplotlib figures from the recorded synthetic experiment

projects.title: GPU Infrastructure Zero to Hero
projects.description: Build intuition for VRAM, inference, GPU telemetry, power, cooling, and Kubernetes placement.
projects.scope: The academy separates calculations and synthetic telemetry from hardware-dependent execution.
projects.why: Build intuition for VRAM, inference, GPU telemetry, power, cooling, and Kubernetes placement.

projects.title: GPU Signal Atlas
projects.description: Connect GPU telemetry with reviewed documentation, retrieval traces, and cited signal cards.
projects.scope: This is evidence-based interpretation and review; it does not execute recovery actions or claim a single signal proves a cause.
projects.why: Follow GPU signals through retrieval, citations, benchmark comparisons, and the evidence behind a result.

projects.title: Inference Regression Lab
projects.description: Compare streaming inference observations with compatible baselines and explicit quality checks.
projects.scope: Protocol replay is synthetic. Real benchmarks require a configured local model endpoint and retain their declared measurement context.
projects.why: Compare streaming inference observations with compatible baselines and explicit quality checks.

projects.title: LLM Serving Observatory
projects.description: See how prefill, decode, KV caches, memory planning, and observability fit into LLM serving.
projects.scope: Public exercises distinguish analytical and simulated views from measured source-lab telemetry. Private inference services remain separate.
projects.why: A visual introduction to the moving parts of serving, with a source laboratory for deeper experiments.

projects.title: RackLens AI
projects.description: Connect Redfish hardware signals with GPU, network, power, and workload evidence for infrastructure review.
projects.scope: The hosted experience uses Redfish-shaped demo telemetry with a replay fallback. The optional edge service reads authorized endpoints; no Redfish write operation is implemented.
projects.why: Connect Redfish hardware signals with GPU, network, power, and workload evidence for infrastructure review.

projects.title: Container Runtime Observatory
projects.description: Inspect container startup, resource pressure, and interference while separating guest and host measurements.
projects.scope: The project distinguishes synthetic analysis, public-series analysis, and live local-runtime experiments.
projects.why: Inspect container startup, resource pressure, and interference while separating guest and host measurements.

projects.title: Fleet Infrastructure Catalog
projects.description: Reconcile infrastructure inventory while retaining service ownership, conflicts, and field provenance.
projects.scope: The included inventory is fictional. Import adapters consume supplied snapshots; continuous source polling is not implemented.
projects.why: Reconcile infrastructure inventory while retaining service ownership, conflicts, and field provenance.

projects.title: Fleet Kernel Workbench
projects.description: Connect bounded Linux eBPF observations with service ownership and telemetry-delivery experiments.
projects.scope: Replay and fictional catalog metadata are labeled. Actual eBPF capture requires compatible Linux support.
projects.why: Connect bounded Linux eBPF observations with service ownership and telemetry-delivery experiments.

projects.title: Redfish Zero to Hero
projects.description: Learn server components, management controllers, HTTP, and Redfish through guided experiments.
projects.scope: Default lessons run locally. The README distinguishes illustrated teaching material from actual lab operations.
projects.why: Learn server components, management controllers, HTTP, and Redfish through guided experiments.

projects.title: RobotReplay
projects.description: Review robotics practice video, inspect visible evidence, and choose the next student-led experiment.
projects.scope: The app does not score games or control robots. Its local demo uses generated media; inference and hardware readings are explicitly bounded.
projects.why: Review robotics practice video, inspect visible evidence, and choose the next student-led experiment.

projects.title: Athlete Living Atlas
projects.description: Explore wearable observations through animated heart, trail, sleep, and agent-evaluation scenes.
projects.scope: Public health scenes use fictional fixtures. The demo is not an Apple Watch stream or a medical-readiness assessment.
projects.why: Explore wearable observations through animated heart, trail, sleep, and agent-evaluation scenes.

projects.title: Athlete Observatory
projects.description: Bring workout observations, evidence quality, and agent-evaluation traces into Python-generated Grafana dashboards.
projects.scope: The public demo uses fictional health data. Published repository screenshots have their own documented provenance.
projects.why: Bring workout observations, evidence quality, and agent-evaluation traces into Python-generated Grafana dashboards.

projects.title: Burro Race Replay
projects.description: Connect a personal race replay with software experiments for a small burro-racing community.
projects.scope: Public setup fixtures and support incidents are fictional. Recorded race evidence and community rehearsal have distinct source context.
projects.why: Connect a personal race replay with software experiments for a small burro-racing community.

projects.title: RaceTime Copilot
projects.description: Catch up on a race-video interval with timestamped evidence and explicit spoiler boundaries.
projects.scope: Live catch-up requires captured coverage. Illustrative screens and configured model behavior are described in the source.
projects.why: A practical bridge between long race coverage, missed moments, and recaps that link back to evidence.

projects.title: RaceTime Replay
projects.description: Align runner video with workout data to compare effort, visible context, and moments worth revisiting.
projects.scope: The comparison supports review; it does not establish the cause of a change or prove a performance improvement.
projects.why: Align runner video with workout data to compare effort, visible context, and moments worth revisiting.

projects.title: UltraMedia Studio
projects.description: Turn race signals into cited newsroom drafts with an inspectable AI workflow and human editorial review.
projects.scope: The portfolio prototype uses fictional race fixtures and has no connected live-race feed or automatic publication path.
projects.why: Turn race signals into cited newsroom drafts with an inspectable AI workflow and human editorial review.

projects.title: CommonGround AI
projects.description: Practice restorative conversations with retrieved guidance, fictional scenarios, and human review.
projects.scope: A training and portfolio demonstration using fictional scenarios. It does not decide real-case eligibility or replace trained practitioners.
projects.why: Practice restorative conversations with retrieved guidance, fictional scenarios, and human review.

projects.title: Hatti Quest
projects.description: Use small language adventures and familiar voices to help children stay connected with Badaga and family.
projects.scope: Families and fluent speakers supply reviewed language and recordings. AI scaffolds do not substitute for language validation.
projects.why: A different side of the portfolio: playful software that makes room for language, culture, and family conversations.

projects.title: Nalam
projects.description: Explore Tamil voice questions, everyday wellness check-ins, and a separate caregiver-review workflow.
projects.scope: A first version for family review. It provides educational support and is not clinically validated.
projects.why: Explore Tamil voice questions, everyday wellness check-ins, and a separate caregiver-review workflow.

projects.title: Nanga Hatti
projects.description: Keep Nilgiris memories in their original words, explore the landscape, and review source-linked context before saving.
projects.scope: The public explorer contains fictional starter memories and recorded engineering evidence. Contribution, clarification, review and private saving run in the local Python app. Engineering evals do not certify language or cultural accuracy.
projects.why: A follow-on to Hatti Quest that connects people and place with a bounded agent, contributor review and inspectable execution evidence.

projects.title: Pausewell
projects.description: Prepare an appointment agenda from selected records and reviewed questions, with an optional wellness check-in.
projects.scope: The application supports preparation rather than diagnosis or treatment. Reported evaluation results use synthetic cases.
projects.why: Prepare an appointment agenda from selected records and reviewed questions, with an optional wellness check-in.

projects.title: Shop Concierge
projects.description: Organize product enquiries into buyer-confirmed draft work orders for a small shop.
projects.scope: The public source describes a private merchant workspace. Sample enquiries are fictional; no public customer-data access or automatic order placement is provided.
projects.why: Organize product enquiries into buyer-confirmed draft work orders for a small shop.

projects.title: Badaga Care Circle
projects.description: Explore English/Tamil community-care education, human-reviewed drafts, shared caregiving and family backup plans.
projects.scope: A local fictional-data demonstration for one Badaga hatti. Medical content and Tamil wording await clinical and native-language approval. Demo role selectors are not authentication. Optional OpenAI adapters are contract-tested; no live model call or clinical field validation has been performed. The app does not send messages, book care or place emergency calls.
projects.imageKind: Architecture illustration for the fictional-data demo
projects.why: Turns concern about caretaker burden and family continuity into explicit handovers, reviewable education and inspectable software evidence.

projects.title: CirclePath
projects.description: Coordinate restorative-justice volunteers from case review to reintegration, with reviewed AI drafts and clear follow-through.
projects.scope: A password-authenticated local demonstration using fictional cases. Live Gemini drafting, Arize export and the local Grafana stack were exercised. People decide consent, readiness, repair agreements and case outcomes. Google Calendar synchronization needs a separate OAuth connection and has not been live-tested; personal .ics exports work locally. Email is disabled. This is not a deployed juvenile case-management service.
projects.why: Connects the scheduling and preparation work behind a restorative process: a qualified team, participant choices, meeting check-ins, repair support and reviewed learning.
projects.imageKind: Workflow and architecture illustration for the local demo
